mutations.name: a merge-at-head deposit never joins its PR's live row
kills: a deposit's typed op shows the live row's g10 hold on a merge-at-head, so the page can offer the approve-and-wait tap beside the forced merge

mutations.name: a factory-config-set deposit gets a console tap before its effect lands
kills: a deposit's typed op stays on the terminal for a kind with no console tap yet

mutations.name: a gate finds its live row by scanning every row instead of the run-id map
mutations.replace: return runId === undefined ? undefined : [...rows.values()].find((row) => row.runId.toLowerCase() === runId.toLowerCase());
kills: inbox ordering orders live-sized items in work linear in their count

mutations.name: an inbox item never carries its live row's gate strip
kills: inbox.list on a fixture factory joins each gate on a live PR to its gate strip at that head
inbox.list on a fixture factory shows a gate's unreadable sources as unknown unmet rows without failing the list

mutations.name: the inbox reads its flow without Shepherd's live heads
kills: inbox.list on a fixture factory drops a deposit pinned to an old head of a PR Shepherd watches at a newer one
